name: Baracchi Smeriglio Sangiovese
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (baracchiwinery.com) Tuscan Sangiovese from Baracchi estate in Cortona. DOC quality - family winery with rich tradition!

🍷 STYLE: Medium-bodied | Bright red cherry, herbs & earthy notes | Fresh acidity, smooth tannins | Classic Tuscan character.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Tomato-based pasta, pizza, grilled meats, charcuterie.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Great introduction to Sangiovese at excellent value. Versatile everyday Italian red perfect for sharing!

name: G.D. Vajra Nebbiolo Clare J.C.
serverNotes:
🌿 ABOUT: (gdvajra.it) Piedmont Nebbiolo from renowned biodynamic producer G.D. Vajra. DOC quality - sustainable winemaking excellence!

🍷 STYLE: Light to medium-bodied | Rose petals, red cherry & herbs | More approachable than Barolo | Early-drinking | Classic Piedmont elegance.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Pasta, lighter meats, mushrooms, truffle dishes.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Great introduction to Nebbiolo grape from a quality producer. Excellent value for this pedigree!

name: Valentina Montepulciano d'Abruzzo
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: Montepulciano d'Abruzzo from central Italy. DOC quality - classic Abruzzo red from the Adriatic coast!

🍷 STYLE: Medium-bodied | Dark cherry, plum & soft tannins | Easy-drinking, versatile | Crowd-pleasing Italian style.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Pizza, pasta, red sauce dishes, grilled meats.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Great value everyday wine. Perfect house bottle for casual Italian dining!

name: Ascheri Langhe Barbera
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (matteoascheri.it) Piedmont Barbera from Ascheri in Langhe. DOC quality - traditional Piedmont winemaking!

🍷 STYLE: Medium-bodied | Bright cherry, red fruit & high acidity | Food-friendly, versatile | Classic Piedmont character.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Tomato-based pasta, charcuterie, pizza, Italian cuisine.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Perfect entry-level Italian red. Great value bottle from a quality Langhe producer!

name: G.D. Vajra Dolcetto D'Alba
serverNotes:
🌿 ABOUT: (gdvajra.it) Dolcetto d'Alba from renowned biodynamic producer G.D. Vajra. DOC quality - sustainable Piedmont excellence!

🍷 STYLE: Light to medium-bodied | Dark cherry, almond & soft tannins | Easy-drinking, slightly fruity | Approachable Piedmont style.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Antipasto, lighter pastas, roasted chicken, everyday meals.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Perfect everyday Italian wine from a top producer. Quality you can trust!

name: "Rosina" Barbera D'Asti by Garetto
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (tenutagaretto.it) Classic Piedmont Barbera from Garretto. DOCG quality - Barbera d'Asti at its finest! Also available by the glass.

🍷 STYLE: Medium-bodied | Bright cherry, plum & vibrant acidity | Food-friendly versatility | Traditional Piedmont character.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Tomato dishes, charcuterie, pasta, Italian cuisine.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Available by the glass too - great for larger parties wanting to share. The high acidity cuts through rich sauces beautifully!

name: Banfi Chianti Superiore
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: Sangiovese-based Chianti Superiore from Castello Banfi in Tuscany. Superiore means stricter yields and a longer minimum age than basic Chianti.

🍷 STYLE: Medium-bodied Tuscan red | Red cherry, plum, violet & dried herbs | Bright acidity, soft tannins | Classic food wine

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Chicken or eggplant Parmesan, three meatballs, pizza, Pappardelle Bolognese, red-sauce pastas.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: A strong bottle to suggest for the table; check the vintage on the list when presenting.

name: Castello Banfi Rosso di Montalcino
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (castellobanfi.com) Rosso di Montalcino from Castello Banfi. DOC quality - 'Baby Brunello' from famous Brunello producer!

🍷 STYLE: Medium-bodied Sangiovese | Cherry, herbs & soft tannins | Younger, more approachable | Introduction to Montalcino style.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Red sauce pasta, grilled meats, pizza, Italian classics.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Great introduction to Montalcino wines at accessible price. Same terroir as Brunello, earlier drinking!

name: Bussola Valpolicella Ripasso
serverNotes:
🍇 ABOUT: (bussolavini.com) Valpolicella Ripasso from Bussola in Veneto. DOCG quality - made with special 'ripasso' method! Also available by the glass.

🍷 STYLE: Medium to full-bodied | Rich cherry, raisin & spice | Re-fermented on Amarone grape skins | Smooth, velvety texture | Step up from regular Valpolicella.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Osso buco, roasted meats, risotto, braised dishes.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: The ripasso method adds richness and complexity. Think of it as 'baby Amarone'! Available by the glass too.

name: Benanti Etna Rosso
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (benanti.it) Unique Sicilian red from volcanic Mt. Etna slopes by Benanti. DOC quality - Nerello Mascalese grape. Trendy & conversation starter!

🍷 STYLE: Light-bodied | Red cherry, herbs, mineral & smoke | High acidity | Volcanic terroir | Food-friendly Italian wine.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Grilled vegetables, fish, lighter meats, seafood.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Trendy wine from one of Sicily's most exciting regions. Perfect for wine enthusiasts seeking something unique!

name: Antinori Chianti Classico Riserva
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (antinori.it) Premium Chianti from legendary 600-year-old Antinori family. DOCG Riserva quality - prestigious Italian wine dynasty!

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Sangiovese | Dark cherry, spice & oak | Richer, more complex than regular Chianti | Aged longer, fuller body | Traditional Tuscan excellence.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Bistecca, wild boar, mature cheese, hearty Tuscan dishes.

🍾 DECANTING: Recommended 30-60 minutes before serving to soften tannins and open up complex aromatics.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Step-up Tuscan choice from one of Italy's most prestigious wine families. Perfect for special occasions!

name: Carpineto Vino Nobile di Montepulciano Riserva
pronunciation: car-pee-NAY-toh VEE-noh NOH-bee-lay dee mon-tay-pull-chee-AH-noh ree-SEHR-vah
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (carpineto.com) Premium Vino Nobile di Montepulciano Riserva from Carpineto. Aged longer than standard, more complex. Tuscan elegance from historic producer!

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Riserva | Dark cherry, leather & spice | Structured tannins | Elegant Tuscan character | Age-worthy.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Roasted meats, game, aged cheese, Tuscan classics.

🍾 DECANTING: Recommended 30-60 minutes to soften tannins and enhance complexity.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Step-up from standard Vino Nobile. Riserva quality!

name: Caparzo Brunello di Montalcino
serverNotes:
👑 ABOUT: (caparzo.com) Classic Brunello di Montalcino from historic Caparzo producer. 100% Sangiovese. Prestigious Tuscan DOCG!

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Brunello | Dark cherry, leather, tobacco & herbs | Structured tannins, age-worthy | Classic Montalcino character.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Bistecca Fiorentina, lamb, aged cheese, Tuscan cuisine.

🍾 DECANTING: Recommended 1-2 hours before serving to open up concentrated flavors and soften structured tannins.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Prestigious Tuscan wine. Special occasion choice!

name: Campogiovanni Brunello di Montalcino
serverNotes:
👑 ABOUT: (sanfelice.com) Brunello di Montalcino from Campogiovanni estate. 100% Sangiovese with traditional winemaking. Highly rated by Wine Spectator. Prestigious DOCG!

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Brunello | Dark cherry, leather, earth & spice | Structured, complex | Traditional Tuscan elegance | Age-worthy.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Bistecca, game, truffles, aged Pecorino, Tuscan classics.

🍾 DECANTING: Recommended 1-2 hours before serving to open up concentrated flavors and soften structured tannins.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Classic Brunello for serious wine lovers. Highly rated quality!

name: G.D. Vajra Barolo Albe
serverNotes:
🌿 ABOUT: (gdvajra.it) Barolo Albe from biodynamic producer G.D. Vajra! 'Albe' means 'dawn' - entry-level Barolo with classic character. Organic & biodynamic.

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Barolo | Rose, tar, cherry & truffle | Firm tannins, elegant | Traditional Nebbiolo | Piedmont excellence.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Braised meats, truffle pasta, aged cheese, osso buco.

🍾 DECANTING: Recommended 1-2 hours before serving to soften firm tannins and release complex aromatics (rose, tar, truffle).

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Accessible Barolo from renowned biodynamic producer. King of Italian wines!

name: Altesino Brunello di Montalcino
serverNotes:
👑 ABOUT: (altesino.it) Prestigious Brunello di Montalcino from Altesino estate. 100% Sangiovese with classic Montalcino character. Historic producer since 1970.

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Brunello | Rich cherry, tobacco, leather & earth | Elegant structure, refined tannins | Traditional excellence.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Grilled meats, bistecca, game, aged cheese, truffles.

🍾 DECANTING: Recommended 1-2 hours before serving to open up concentrated flavors and soften structured tannins.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Classic Brunello from historic estate. Benchmark Tuscan wine!

name: Gagliardo Barolo
serverNotes:
👑 ABOUT: (gagliardo.it) Classic Barolo from Gagliardo family estate in La Morra. Traditional Nebbiolo winemaking. King of Italian wines from prestigious producer!

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Barolo | Rose, tar, cherry & truffle | Firm tannins, complex | Traditional Piedmont style | Age-worthy excellence.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Braised meats, truffle dishes, aged cheese, osso buco.

🍾 DECANTING: Recommended 1-2 hours before serving to soften firm tannins and release complex aromatics (rose, tar, truffle).

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Traditional Barolo for serious wine enthusiasts. Piedmont royalty!

name: Tommasi Amarone
serverNotes:
👑 ABOUT: (tommasiwine.it) Premium Amarone della Valpolicella from Tommasi family. Made from dried grapes (appassimento) for concentrated intensity. Veneto masterpiece!

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Amarone | Rich dried fruit, chocolate, raisin & spice | Velvety, powerful | Traditional appassimento method.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Braised meats, game, aged cheese, chocolate desserts.

🍾 DECANTING: Recommended 1-2 hours to open up intense, concentrated dried-grape flavors and velvety texture.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Classic Amarone experience. Legendary Veneto style!

name: Gagliardo "Fossati" Barolo
serverNotes:
👑 ABOUT: (gagliardo.it) 'Fossati' single-vineyard Barolo from Gagliardo estate. Premium cru from specific vineyard site. Enhanced complexity and aging potential!

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Barolo | Rose, tar, cherry & truffle | Complex, powerful | Single-vineyard character | Age-worthy.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Truffle dishes, braised meats, game, aged cheese.

🍾 DECANTING: Recommended 1-2 hours before serving to soften firm tannins and release complex aromatics (rose, tar, truffle).

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Single-vineyard Barolo. Step-up from standard Gagliardo!

name: Bertani Amarone Classico
serverNotes:
👑 ABOUT: (bertani.net) Amarone Classico from historic Bertani estate (est. 1857). Traditional appassimento method with dried grapes. One of Veneto's most respected producers!

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Amarone | Rich dried fruit, chocolate, raisin & spice | Velvety, elegant | Traditional Valpolicella character.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Braised meats, game, aged cheese, chocolate desserts.

🍾 DECANTING: Recommended 1-2 hours to open up intense, concentrated dried-grape flavors and velvety texture.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Historic producer's Amarone. Classic Veneto excellence!

name: Gaja Sperss Barolo
serverNotes:
🏆 ABOUT: (gaja.com) Sperss Barolo - Gaja's flagship Piedmont masterpiece! Single-vineyard Barolo from legendary producer. One of Italy's greatest wines. Investment-grade!

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Barolo | Extraordinary complexity | Rose, tar, truffle & dark fruit | World-class power & elegance.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: White truffle, finest cuts, once-in-lifetime celebrations.

🍾 DECANTING: Recommended 1-2 hours before serving to soften firm tannins and release complex aromatics (rose, tar, truffle).

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Gaja's Barolo flagship. Ultimate Italian wine for serious collectors!
